ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis is 2001—2007, the unit of the vertical axis is ten thousand people, and it contains three lines: “total growth”, “natural growth”, and “mechanical growth”. From 2001 to 2007, the natural growth line as a whole was at a relatively low level, with little change; the mechanical growth line rose noticeably after 2005; total growth also rose significantly in the later period. Then reason: The stem states that Jiangsu will enter the fourth population birth peak period from 2008 to 2013, and requires “stabilizing the current low fertility level”. The birth peak is mainly related to fertility behavior, not the issue of mechanical migration growth. Therefore, population policy measures that directly suppress the birth peak and maintain a low fertility level should be adopted, namely advocating late marriage and late childbearing.

raw_record.answer: Advocate late marriage and late childbearing
